next.reason: 1985: 'The USAGE clause may be written in any data description entry' of the Report Section. §2023:13.15.2 offers '[ USAGE IS ] { DISPLAY | NATIONAL }' in every report group description entry, and it is not among the elementary-only clauses; §2023:13.15.4 GR2 applies the data description USAGE rules, whose placement bar §2023:13.18.60.3 SR1 ('shall not be specified in a data description entry that has a level-number of 66 or 88') no report group entry meets. Same placement; the rule refuses nothing in either edition.
